summary: Keep the RAM-only checkpoint directory at 8192 manifests
compatibility: No user action required. --checkpoint-index-max-entries still overrides both defaults.
details: A persistent checkpoint directory (--checkpoint-index-path, used with disk storage) keeps 65536 manifests so it covers what L2 retains.
A RAM-only directory keeps manifests in server memory, tens to hundreds of KiB each for long GLM prompts, while its payloads live only in RAM; it stays at the previous 8192.
